'''Blackwater Systems''' '''facility''', owned and operated by [[Blackwater Systems]] corporation (established by [[Granta Omega]]), was a factory that manufactured and tested the [[Jenna Zan Arbor]]-created drug, the [[Zone of Self-Containment]].

Constructed of black [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and stone, and described as consisting of a main hulking building with a wing flung out from one side like a useless arm, the secret, windowless facility was located in the [[Yellow District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Falleen Throne]]. Situated beyond the city's outskirts on frigid, windswept plains, it was two kilometers from the nearest [[Cloud bus|cloud-bus]] stop.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This facility featured in the young adult novel ''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]'', written by [[Jude Watson]] and published in [[July]] [[2004]].
